detections.ruleName: Hidden cross-origin iframe inserted after load

detections.summary: A hidden cross-origin iframe was inserted after load.

alternativeExplanations: A viewability, verification or cookie-sync frame inserted by an ordinary ad.
A consent or login helper frame.
detections.confidenceRationale: A hidden cross-origin frame was observed, but no ad-selection request preceded it in the same frame lineage, and such frames are common in ordinary advertising.

evidence.observed: The page sensor observed a hidden cross-origin iframe targeting match.sharethrough.com inserted 885 ms after the frame loaded in a frame on csync.smilewanted.com.
